name: Great Shaman Fruitable
body:
Prerequisite(s): Fruitable, shaman alternate racial trait.

Benefits: The fruitable’s telepathy range increases to 20 feet, plus 5 feet per 2 Hit Dice the fruitable possesses. This increased telepathy range does not allow the fruitable to see or hear using a creature’s senses if they were not in contact with the fruitable. In addition, the fruitable chooses one 1st-level spell from the druid’s spell list and may cast that spell once per day as a spell-like ability. Just like the fruitable’s other spell-like abilities granted by the shaman alternate racial trait, this spell is treated as being from a fey source for the purposes of the druid’s resist nature’s lure class feature and similar abilities.
